kurz: Whether the surroundings are acidic or alkaline changes browning, colour, bite and rising power.
bild_im_kopf: A balance between lemon and baking soda.
was_passiert: Alkaline speeds up browning and softens vegetables. Acidic keeps vegetables firm, turns red cabbage red and stops apples browning. Baking soda needs acid to make gas.
faustregeln: For faster browning, a pinch of baking soda.
For firm vegetables and fresh flavour, a little acid.
